Hi Jordan — great to meet earlier today. Wanted to recap the key points and propose next steps so we can get your ML/infra team aligned.

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary goal: reduce per-call inference latency for patient triage flows while keeping monthly inference costs predictable.
- Current constraints: on-prem model hosting w/ bursty traffic (peak M-F 9a–5p), strict audit/logging requirements, and limited GPU capacity.
- Success signals: P95 latency < 200ms for short prompts, predictable unit cost under monthly commit, and audit-ready logs for model versioning.

Recommended next step: technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with your ML+infra leads so we can:
1) review current serving topology and request patterns,
2) align on model variants and quantization tradeoffs,
3) walk through routing/fallback & KV-caching options, and
4) agree on rollout plan and measurement hooks.

Proposed window(s):
- Wed 20 May — 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred)
- Thu 21 May — 13:00–14:30 PT
- Fri 22 May — 09:00–10:30 PT

If those don't work, you can pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-deep-dive

Please confirm: (a) attendees on your side (ML lead, infra/ops, security if needed), (b) preferred duration (60 vs 90 min), and (c) any specific agenda items you want covered.

Attaching a short sample agenda and our security overview for context. If helpful I'll loop in our solutions engineer (Marissa) and infra lead (Lukas) to lead the technical sections.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
